name: Summer Contribution Margin Realized
baseline: Lost ₹23.31 Cr net profit in summer season
target: ₹184.32 Cr summer CM realized (>=97% of potential)
trigger_condition: weekly trajectory >3% behind target potential
caption_template: Summer CM trajectory is {val_pct}% behind target, risking seasonal contribution margin.

name: Stock Out Revenue Loss Rate
baseline: 8% of summer revenue (₹46.08 Cr) lost to stock-outs
target: <1.0% stock-out rate across all SKUs
trigger_condition: weekly SKU unfulfilled demand rate >3%
caption_template: Stock-out rate across key retail accounts is {val_pct}%, risking brand listing penalties.

name: Overstock Write Off Value
baseline: ₹6.00 Cr in write-offs and distress discounting
target: <₹0.50 Cr total seasonal write-offs
trigger_condition: projected depot exposure value exceeds ₹10 lakh
caption_template: Projected inventory overstock write-off exposure stands at ₹{val_fmt} across slow-moving depots.

name: Emergency Freight Premium Ratio
baseline: 5.0x normal freight (₹3.2 Cr air vs ₹0.64 Cr road)
target: 1.0x (zero unbudgeted emergency air freight)
trigger_condition: air-to-road cost ratio >2.0x
caption_template: Air-to-road expedited freight ratio is {val}x normal baseline (target: zero air penalty).

name: Competitive Shelf Loss Risk
baseline: Rival took shelf space within 6 weeks of stockouts
target: Zero permanent MT/QC listing losses
trigger_condition: consecutive stock-out days at MT or QC >= 10
caption_template: Consecutive retail out-of-stock count reached {val} days; competitor shelf displacement risk.

name: Demand Sensing Latency
baseline: Month-end batch sales visibility (~30 days latency)
target: <24 hours automated data ingestion
trigger_condition: channel sales report ingest latency > 48 hours
caption_template: Channel sales automated ingest pipeline latency is {val} hours (target: <24h daily refresh).

name: Forecast Error Rate
baseline: 30% average error at flavor and depot level
target: <15% weighted absolute error
trigger_condition: rolling 7-day forecast error > 20%
caption_template: Rolling 7-day forecast error rate is {val_pct}% across core SKU volume (threshold: 20%).

name: QC Velocity Deviation
baseline: 4x viral spike completely missed for 2+ weeks
target: Trigger fires same day deviation crosses 25%
trigger_condition: 3-day rolling QC sell-through deviation from forecast exceeds threshold
caption_template: QC demand for {flavor} is {val_pct}% above forecast, viral sell-through velocity detected.

name: GT Primary Billing Velocity Conflict
baseline: No outlet POS data; month-end distributor summaries
target: Early proxy billing divergence detected within 48h
trigger_condition: depot primary billing velocity conflicts with QC/MT trend by >20%
caption_template: Depot primary billing velocity conflicts with QC and MT sell-through by {val_pct}%.

name: Plant Utilization Rate
baseline: Ran at 95% with zero spare buffer
target: Operate 92% to 95%, trigger co-packer before 95% is reached
trigger_condition: projected 14-day plant utilization crosses threshold
caption_template: Plant running at {val_pct}% utilization; buffer capacity approaching co-packer notice cutoff.

name: Co-Packer Lead Time Compliance
baseline: 2-week notice window missed, triggered too late
target: Notice issued strictly >= 14 days before capacity wall
trigger_condition: days of notice provided before capacity breach < 14
caption_template: Advance co-packer notice provided is {val} days (contractual requirement: >=14 days).

name: Frozen Pulp Cover Days
baseline: Held only 14 days of passionfruit pulp heading into May closure
target: Maintain 35 to 42 days buffer (min 28 days) in plant cold storage
trigger_condition: plant pulp inventory cover days < 28 between April 1 and June 30
caption_template: {ingredient} inventory at {val} days cover; pre-monsoon safe buffer target is 35 days.

name: Single Source Dependency Ratio
baseline: 100% of passionfruit volume tied to single cooperative
target: <15% volume exposure at 100% single source
trigger_condition: single-source ingredient summer volume share > 15%
caption_template: Single-source ingredient volume exposure is {val_pct}% tied to one cooperative.

name: Total Landed Risk-Adjusted Cost
baseline: Procurement scored only on nominal price/kg
target: Scored on risk-adjusted cost including disruption probability
trigger_condition: nominal cost favored despite risk-adjusted cost saving > 5%
caption_template: Landed procurement cost evaluation shows {val_pct}% potential savings via risk-adjusted sourcing.

name: Raw Pulp Safety Buffer Index
baseline: 14 days buffer vs 180 day pulp stability
target: >=35 days buffer prior to monsoon season
trigger_condition: safety buffer days before seasonal window < 35
caption_template: Pre-monsoon safety buffer index is {val} days prior to seasonal disruption window.

name: Depot Finished Goods Cover Days
baseline: Static 21 days cover across all depots
target: Dynamic 10-14 days cover based on weekly velocity
trigger_condition: depot cover days > 16 for a fast-decay SKU
caption_template: Depot finished goods inventory holds {val} cover days (dynamic target: 10-14 days).

name: Batch Age at Risk
baseline: No batch tracking; ₹6 Cr write-offs at 30-day MT/QC cliff
target: Zero batches cross day 18 without transfer recommendation
trigger_condition: batch age reaches 18 days and depot sell-through won't clear in 7 days
caption_template: {val} batches have crossed age 18d without transfer, risking commercial shelf write-off.

name: MT/QC Rejection Incident Rate
baseline: Repeated rejections for <60 days residual shelf-life
target: Zero rejection events across summer
trigger_condition: batch commercial age crosses 30 days without sale
caption_template: Commercial shelf-life breach: {val} batches aged past 30 days face mandatory return or discount.

name: Cold Chain In-Transit Temp Excursion
baseline: No real-time reefer monitoring
target: Zero excursions >2°C over optimal setpoint
trigger_condition: transit temperature deviation > 2.0 degrees C
caption_template: Cold chain transit reefer telemetry records {val}°C maximum temperature excursion.

name: Depot Stock Imbalance Index
baseline: Allocated by last year's mix; some depots choked, others dry
target: Depot cover-day variance <6 days across regions
trigger_condition: cover-day variance across depots for single SKU > 10 days
caption_template: Regional depot finished goods cover variance spans {val} days between fastest and slowest hubs.

name: Inter Depot Transfer Utilization
baseline: Transfers rarely executed, leading to local write-offs
target: 100% of recommended transfers actioned within 48h
trigger_condition: recommended transfer unactioned for > 48 hours
caption_template: Inter-depot rebalancing transfer unactioned for {val} hours (SLA: 48h execution cutoff).

name: New SKU Allocation Weight
baseline: 0% weight in historical mix, starved of inventory
target: >=70% dynamic real-time velocity weighting for new SKUs
trigger_condition: new SKU dynamic weighting in allocation engine < 70%
caption_template: New SKU dynamic allocation weight is {val_pct}% based on live channel velocity telemetry.

name: Channel Fair Share Fulfillment Ratio
baseline: Ad-hoc dispatching cannibalized high-margin channels
target: >=90% fair share allocation compliance
trigger_condition: high-margin channel fulfillment ratio < 85%
caption_template: High-margin channel fulfillment ratio is {val_pct}% under fair-share allocation rules.

name: Route Risk Window Vulnerability
baseline: Highway closed 3 of 5 summers (60% historical probability)
target: Pulp buffer secured before seasonal landslide window opens
trigger_condition: date between April 15 and June 30 AND pulp cover < 35 days
caption_template: Seasonal highway closure window risk vulnerability index is {val} (April 15 to June 30).

name: Emergency vs Planned Freight Mix
baseline: Spent ₹3.2 Cr emergency air freight at 5x normal rate
target: <2% of total freight volume moved via emergency expediting
trigger_condition: single emergency freight booking > ₹25 lakh or share > 15%
caption_template: Emergency vs. planned freight mix ratio is {val_pct}% of total summer logistics budget.

name: Secondary Logistics Carrier Readiness
baseline: Zero pre-contracted backup carriers during highway crisis
target: >=80% contracted multi-modal secondary carrier readiness
trigger_condition: secondary route readiness score < 80%
caption_template: Secondary multi-modal logistics carrier readiness score is {val_pct}% across bypass routes.

name: QC to Supply Chain Pipe Latency
baseline: Marketing received daily reports; planners saw them month-end
target: Automated ingestion pipeline latency < 24 hours
trigger_condition: pipeline data freshness delay > 24 hours
caption_template: Quick Commerce to supply chain automated data pipe latency is {val} hours.

name: MT Signal Capture Rate
baseline: Weekly store-level stock data was fragmented
target: 100% MT EDI/portal signal capture rate
trigger_condition: MT signal capture completeness < 100%
caption_template: Modern Trade EDI and portal signal capture completeness stands at {val_pct}%.

name: Planner Active Usage Rate
baseline: 2 previous digital pilots stalled after go-live
target: >=85% weekly active planner adoption across all 15 planners
trigger_condition: planner weekly active interaction rate < 70%
caption_template: Weekly active planner adoption and interaction rate is {val_pct}% across 15 supply planners.

name: Alert to Decision SLA
baseline: S&OP met monthly; urgent decisions sat without action
target: Planner SLA 4h, Supply Lead 12h, COO 24h
trigger_condition: pending alert exceeds SLA deadline hours without decision
caption_template: Pending operational alert response delay is {val} hours past assigned authority tier SLA.

name: Alert False Positive Rate
baseline: Alert fatigue in past tools caused complete disuse
target: <15% override rate for each alert type
trigger_condition: monthly alert override rate exceeds 25%
caption_template: Monthly false-positive alert override rate is {val_pct}% (H3 governance threshold: 25%).
